cases.description: A warm jacket for a cold trek, with a budget written as "8k" and a size.

turns.user: I'm going trekking in Ladakh in December, need a jacket under 8k, size L.
turns.reply:
Prioritize extreme-warmth down jackets.
For Ladakh in December, go for an extreme-warmth down jacket; the TrekNorth Summit and Monsoonwear Ridge are also waterproof, and the Monsoonwear costs much less. The AltiGear is a women's fit, and fleece works best as a layer under a down jacket.

cases.description: Adding an attribute keeps the earlier budget and size.

turns.user: I'm going trekking in Ladakh in December, need a jacket under 8k, size L.
turns.reply: For Ladakh in December, go with an extreme-warmth down jacket. The TrekNorth Summit is the best all-rounder, and the Monsoonwear Ridge costs much less but has fewer reviews. The fleece jackets work better as a mid-layer under a down jacket than on their own.

The UrbanLayer Pamir stands out because it's extreme-warmth, very light and well reviewed, and it's one of the cheaper ones. The jackets rated high warmth instead of extreme (Himfrost, TrekNorth Pamir, AltiGear) will need more layers under them for Ladakh in December.

cases.description: Narrowing to one brand keeps the type and budget.

turns.reply: PaceOne Terra is the top-rated pick and comes in every size, and TrailKing Apex gets the same rating for about half the price. If you'll be out in wet weather, UrbanStep Glide is the best-rated waterproof pair.
TrailKing Apex at ₹2,569 is the best value, but it isn't waterproof. If you'll trek in rain, the Metro (SHO-00221) is the top-rated waterproof pick, and the waterproof Terra costs less.

cases.description: An inferred extreme-warmth filter finds nothing under ₹2,000; dropping it (the user never said it) does.

turns.reply:
Warmth was inferred; drop it.
Nothing under ₹2,000 has extreme warmth. At most these are rated moderate, and none will be enough for -20°C by itself. The Snowline fleece is the warmest, and it works best as a layer under a shell, so think about raising your budget for a down jacket.
